description: This file defines a class 'PublisherDelete' responsible for listing and deleting pages in a Confluence documentation setup. It interacts with an API client and outputs information to the console.
external_files: Api (assumed to be a class in the project)

classes.name: PublisherDelete
classes.description: Handles listing and deleting pages in a Confluence setup, using an API client and output interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing output, delete flag, API client, and deletable pages array.

methods.name: listDeletable
methods.description: Recursively traverses published pages to identify deletable ones.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process deletable pages, either deleting or listing based on the flag.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes pages marked as deletable, outputting status messages.

methods.name: displayDeletable
methods.description: Displays the list of pages marked for deletion without deleting them.
